you can specify the allow-list for metric labels using the `--allow-metric-labels` flag. The key format should be `<MetricName>,<LabelName>`, and the value format should be `<allowed_value>,<allowed_value>... (e.g., metric1,label1='v1,v2,v3')`.

I think this is a legit issue, I tried it on my end and was able to confirm that the flag `--allow-metric-labels` is not being respected for both [scheduler metrics](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/release-1.31/pkg/scheduler/metrics/metrics.go) & [feature enablement metrics](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/release-1.31/staging/src/k8s.io/component-base/metrics/prometheus/feature/metrics.go). I also suspect this issue is affecting all component metrics currently.

I also wonder why this wasn't caught so far. Maybe we should add an e2e test for this metric.

Tried some fixes for kube-scheduler's metrics & feature enablement metrics in [PR1](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/126762) & [PR2](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/126763), maybe there's a better way to apply the flag correctly to metrics here.

cc @logicalhan for visibility

/reopen

review_comments: why are the reset() being called twice?
Ah I see reset() is not called for the other tests. Maybe we should add a cleanup() for all tests that can do this resetting. Can have a TODO for it.
It would clean the metrics value for other tests. An alternative is we can also call the `reset()` in other tests at inception.

I'm also thinking whether we should add the metrics.Reset() in the [tearDown()](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/b240c51a725d6c43221709c9b7a04f937757af37/cmd/kube-apiserver/app/testing/testserver.go#L174) of the TestAPIServer.
I've added a comment with TODO to follow up.
Worth extracting the flag construction into a separate function?
It's an one-off operation dedicated for this test (setup testAPIServer once with the flag including all the test cases), I don't think it is worth to extract this logic out.
